reading_status.definition: Optional per-field reading provenance. Null is unrecorded. A session check may cover particular words only.

mapping.reason: Neither EHRI 0.2.0 nor its imported RiC-O 1.1 encodes independent text and English machine, AI-session-checked or human-corrected states; history and productionTechnique do not express these field-level distinctions.

machine.definition: A machine reading without a recorded qualifying check.

mapping.reason: Application-specific reading provenance state, not a state defined in either pinned ontology.

session_checked.definition: An AI session checked or corrected the field, possibly particular words only.

mapping.reason: Application-specific reading provenance state, not a state defined in either pinned ontology.

person_corrected.definition: A recorded human author corrected the field; AI drafts and approvals alone do not qualify.
